title: Remove redundant algebraic-root kind metadata
status: API and consumer deletions committed on main; all local gates and matched controls pass; broader release readiness remains unproven

change.scope: Only duplicated metadata and its maintenance are removed. Existing interval, point payload, validation and policy-based root decisions remain authoritative. Two clones used only for tag maintenance are replaced with moves. Real payload and interval assertions are preserved; no test is removed.
change.audit: No direct kind-based production dispatch remains. Derived structural equality in tensor-axis elimination previously compared the tag incidentally; identity now compares the remaining root evidence, with the existing strict affine-relation fallback unchanged.

concurrent_hypersolve_work.scope: The separately committed production, benchmark and test hashes match the concurrent source covered by qualification. Its seven tests are included in the native counts. This work is absent from both frozen timing artifacts.

frozen_control.scope: Both sides use the same frozen dependencies; concurrent Hyperreal 2808bc8 conversion changes and concurrent Hypersolve quadratic extraction are excluded. Live qualification uses the current workspace. The frozen Hypercurve offset and parameter files omit some newer inline tests on both sides; all pre-conversion-test source hashes match the live files, and live qualification includes those additional tests.
frozen_control.binary_interpretation: Test file shrinks 60,376 bytes, region file grows 3,856 bytes and its combined text/data/BSS grows 4,108 bytes. No uniform binary-size improvement is claimed.

layouts.scope: Measured release/all-feature native layouts. Removing the tag does not change padding or aggregate layouts in this build.

allocation_control.scope: Small fixture includes both policies and process startup. Not full slow-fixture accounting or a leak-freedom claim.

matched_comparison.output_checks: All 24 invocations exited successfully; each test invocation passed exactly one test. All 19 region rows preserved iteration counts and every emitted checksum across all six samples.
matched_comparison.interpretation: Whole-fixture wall medians: selected 52.11 to 52.61 seconds (+0.96%), chord 17.09 to 17.00 (-0.53%), radial 29.54 to 29.18 (-1.22%), region 6.52 to 6.45 (-1.07%). Individual region lanes are mixed, including retained-algebraic all-operations +5.66% and immediate union -4.49%. Three samples per side do not establish statistical significance or uniformly faster operation performance. Retain for removal of inconsistent metadata and the requested smaller API, not a speedup claim.
matched_comparison.observation_scope: No competing build/test workers were observed in bounded host process audits. One oversized process listing was truncated; a sandboxed piped listing did not expose the running host worker. The original benchmark session remained live and was not restarted; a subsequent bounded host listing confirmed its worker. No measurements were selectively discarded.

Full slow-fixture paired allocation accounting remains incomplete; this pass claims only scoped RSS and the unchanged small allocation control.
